title: teaching-deck skill: reveal.js teaching presentations from Zettelkasten notes
description:
## Goal

A skill that builds teaching presentations as reveal.js decks from the
user's Zettelkasten excerpt.

## Scope

- Fixed layout: `presentation/zettelkasten/`, `presentation/prep/`,
  `presentation/slides/`; one presentation per repository.
- Steps: intake, reading log, understanding summary (gate), timed outline
  (gate), deck build, verification.
- Missing linked notes: ask whether absent on purpose, give copy commands
  from the user's Zettelkasten folders.
- Later sessions: changes/questions and day-of-talk briefing.

## Review

Reviewed by a critic subagent until APPROVE. LLM evals out of scope.
close_reason: Skill written and reviewed to APPROVE by a critic subagent
